onset.Description: Start of the trial segment in this file (trials are written back-to-back)

sample.Description: First sample of the trial segment in the file (0-based)

trial_index.Description: Trial number in the released file (1-based, release order)

trial_time_start.Description: Authors' time axis value of the first sample of the trial (s, relative to the trial's event; n/a if not released)

fear_level.Description: Fear morph level of the face (event.fear)

happy_level.Description: Happy morph level of the face (event.happy)

source_trial_index.Description: Trial index in the released eeg.data (1-based, both sessions)
